title:
Population Aging and Income Inequality in a Semi‐Endogenous Growth Model
                    *
title_zh: 半内生增长模型中的人口老龄化与收入不平等
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a continuous‐time overlapping generations model with semi‐endogenous growth, this study analyzes the impact of population aging on income inequality. We characterize the stationary distributions of household income and wealth and examine how increases in life expectancy and declines in fertility rates affect these distributions. Numerical simulations indicate that longer life expectancy reduces inequality, whereas lower fertility rates increase it. We further explore the distributional effects of exogenous productivity growth under varying degrees of population aging.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用包含半内生增长的连续时间世代交叠模型，分析人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。我们刻画了家庭收入与财富的稳态分布特征，并考察预期寿命延长和生育率下降如何影响这些分布。数值模拟表明，预期寿命延长会降低不平等程度，而生育率下降则会加剧不平等。我们进一步探讨了在不同人口老龄化程度下，外生生产率增长对收入分配的影响。

title: Agentomics: Economic Foundations for the Valuation, Attribution, and Pricing of AI Agents in Human-AI Workflows
title_zh: Agentomics：人机工作流中AI代理的估值、归因与定价的经济学基础
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being deployed as productive resources in organizational workflows, yet existing evaluation methods primarily measure isolated technical performance rather than economic contribution. This paper introduces \emph{Agentomics}, a workflow-based framework for valuing, attributing, and pricing human and artificial agents. The framework models a workflow as a configuration of heterogeneous agents whose collective performance determines gross value, deployment cost, reliability, and expected failure loss. Workflow value is treated as a team-level quantity that may include complementarities, substitution effects, bottlenecks, and nonlinear production; additive stage-level value is only a special case. Building on this workflow model, the paper formulates AI deployment as a coalition-formation problem and defines coalition value as the incremental net surplus generated relative to a benchmark human workflow. The Shapley value is then used to attribute economic surplus among participating AI agents, yielding a principled connection among valuation, accountability, and market pricing. The resulting Shapley pricing equilibrium provides a normative benchmark for assessing whether agent prices reflect expected marginal contribution. A security-operations case study illustrates how the framework accounts for productivity gains, deployment costs, reliability losses, and coalition-level complementarities in hybrid human--AI workflows.
abstract_zh: 自主型人工智能系统正越来越多地被部署为组织工作流程中的生产性资源，然而现有评估方法主要衡量孤立的技术性能而非经济贡献。本文提出"Agentomics"框架，这是一个基于工作流程的评估框架，用于对人类与人工智能代理进行价值评估、贡献归因和定价。该框架将工作流程建模为异质性代理的配置组合，其集体绩效决定了总价值、部署成本、可靠性和预期故障损失。工作流程价值被视为团队层面的量值，可能包含互补性、替代效应、瓶颈和非线性生产；可加性的阶段层面价值仅为特例。基于此工作流程模型，本文将人工智能部署形式化为联盟形成问题，并将联盟价值定义为相对于基准人类工作流程所产生的增量净剩余。随后采用沙普利值对参与的人工智能代理进行经济剩余归因，从而在价值评估、问责机制与市场定价之间建立原则性关联。由此产生的沙普利定价均衡为评估代理价格是否反映预期边际贡献提供了规范性基准。通过安全运营案例研究，本文展示了该框架如何核算人机混合工作流程中的生产力增益、部署成本、可靠性损失及联盟层面互补性。

title: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
title_zh: 社区参与与公共安全：针对移民的犯罪执法证据
authors: Gonçalves, Felipe, Jácome, Elisa, Weisburst, Emily
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10% decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了受害者报案在公共安全产出中的作用。我们考察了“安全社区”计划——一项涉及警方识别非法移民并加剧移民社区驱逐恐惧的犯罪防控政策。研究发现，该政策降低了西班牙裔受害者向警方报案的意愿，并导致针对西班牙裔的犯罪增加。报案犯罪总数未发生变化，掩盖了上述相反效应。我们证明报案减少是犯罪增加的原因，并在文献中首次提供了犯罪对受害者报案的弹性系数，计算得出报案率每下降10%，犯罪率上升7.9%。

title: The Option Value of Municipal Liquidity
title_zh: 市政流动性的期权价值
authors: Haughwout, Andrew, Hyman, Benjamin, Shachar, Or
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: States and localities are relied upon to implement macroeconomic stabilization policies and ensure service delivery in times of crisis. In April 2020, the introduction of the Municipal Liquidity Facility (MLF) added an emergency lending instrument to the policy arsenal guaranteeing liquidity but at a price. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits MLF lending eligibility population cutoffs, we find that the MLF contributed to the easing of liquidity pressures and reduced perceived credit risk for municipal borrowers. Low-rated issuers experienced yields reductions of at least 26 bps. We also provide suggestive evidence that these liquidity effects translated into employment gains.
abstract_zh: 各州及地方政府被寄予厚望，需在危机时期实施宏观经济稳定政策并确保公共服务供给。2020年4月推出的市政流动性便利（MLF）为政策工具箱新增了一项应急贷款工具，该工具虽能保障流动性，但需付出相应代价。通过利用MLF贷款资格的人口阈值进行断点回归设计，我们发现MLF有助于缓解流动性压力，并降低了市政借款人的感知信用风险。低评级发行人的收益率至少下降了26个基点。我们还提供了初步证据表明，这些流动性效应已转化为就业增长。

title: Capital Taxation, Income Shifting, and Retained Earnings: Evidence from Dividend Tax Reforms
title_zh: 资本税、收入转移与留存收益：来自股息税改革的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of dividend tax reforms on tax revenues, income shifting, and earnings retention. It examines two significant policy changes in Israel during the 2010s. Using administrative tax records, we study a permanent five-percentage point increase in the dividend tax rate in 2012, and a temporary tax relief enacted in 2017. The permanent tax hike triggered an immediate surge of over 100% in reported dividend income and tax revenues. It did not generate a lasting shift in dividend flows. In contrast, the temporary relief of 2017 led to a sharp decline in dividend payments upon its expiration. Notably, firms increased earnings retention after the preferential rate ended, potentially anticipating similar future relief. We also find evidence of income shifting via wage-to-dividend conversions for tax planning. Finally, increased earnings retention after 2017 produced a 1–2 percentage point downward bias in the top 1% income share due to unreported dividend income.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了股息税改革对税收收入、收入转移及留存收益的影响。研究聚焦于2010年代以色列两项重大政策变革。基于行政税收记录，我们考察了2012年股息税率永久性提高5个百分点，以及2017年实施的临时性税收减免政策。永久性增税导致申报股息收入及税收收入立即激增逾100%，但并未引发股息流的持续性转移。相比之下，2017年的临时性减免政策在到期后导致股息支付急剧下降。值得注意的是，企业在优惠税率终止后增加了留存收益，这可能是预期未来将出现类似减免措施。我们还发现了通过工资-股息转换进行税务筹划的收入转移证据。最后，2017年后留存收益的增加导致未申报股息收入使顶层1%收入份额产生1-2个百分点的低估偏差。

title: Anchored to the Dot Plot: Central Bank Projections and Interest Rate Expectations
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In January 2012, the Federal Reserve began publishing the Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) "dot plot," revealing FOMC participants' projections for the federal funds rate. This paper documents a dual role for SEP projections in the formation of private interest-rate expectations. On one hand, SEP projections contain valuable information, achieving lower forecast errors than consensus surveys, VAR models, and several market-based measures at many horizons. Because the SEP is informative, some reliance on it by private forecasters is natural. On the other hand, because the SEP is updated only quarterly, SEP projections that are useful when released can become stale between updates. If private forecasts continue to place excessive weight on those earlier projections, they may respond too slowly to newly arriving information. Consistent with this prediction, survey forecast errors-and, to a weaker extent, market-based forecast errors-are systematically related to the gap between current expectations and lagged SEP projections, even after controlling for macroeconomic conditions, risk premia, and other predictors of forecast errors. The findings imply that official guidance can simultaneously improve average forecast accuracy while reducing the speed with which new information is incorporated into expectations.
abstract_zh: 2012年1月，美联储开始发布《经济预测摘要》（SEP）“点阵图”，披露联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）成员对联邦基金利率的预测。本文揭示了SEP预测在私人利率预期形成中的双重作用。一方面，SEP预测包含有价值的信息，在多个预测期限上，其预测误差低于共识调查、VAR模型及若干市场指标。由于SEP信息含量丰富，私人预测者对其产生一定依赖是自然的。另一方面，由于SEP仅每季度更新一次，发布时有效的预测可能在更新间隔期间变得过时。若私人预测持续过度依赖这些早期预测，则可能对新信息的反应过于迟缓。与这一预测一致的是，调查预测误差（以及程度较弱的基于市场的预测误差）与当前预期和滞后SEP预测之间的缺口存在系统性关联，即使在控制宏观经济状况、风险溢价及其他预测误差预测因子后依然如此。研究结果表明，官方指引能够同时提升平均预测准确性，但会降低新信息融入预期的速度。

title: Dollar Trinity and the Global Financial Cycle
title_zh: 美元三位一体与全球金融周期
authors: Gernot Müller, Georgios Georgiadis, Ben Schumann
official: 官方在线 2023-09-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a two-country business-cycle model of the US and the rest of the world with dollar dominance in trade invoicing, in cross-border credit, and in safe assets. The interplay between these elements---dollar trinity---rationalizes salient features of the Global Financial Cycle in the data: When its tide subsides, the dollar appreciates, financial conditions tighten, the world business cycle slows down, and emerging-market central banks face a trade-off between mitigating the recession and dampening price pressures. We find the dollar is no sideshow in this, but central for the transmission of the Global Financial Cycle to the world economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含美国与世界其他地区的两国商业周期模型，其中美元在贸易计价、跨境信贷和安全资产领域占据主导地位。这些要素之间的相互作用——美元三位一体——合理化了数据中全球金融周期的显著特征：当美元潮汐退去时，美元升值，金融状况收紧，全球商业周期放缓，新兴市场央行面临缓解经济衰退与抑制价格压力之间的权衡。我们发现，美元在此过程中并非配角，而是全球金融周期向世界经济传导的核心环节。
